Definition: properly, leanness, i.e. (figuratively) limitation; only adverbial, merely, or conjunctional, although
BiblicalUsage: Raq means only, merely, just — properly, leanness, limitation. Genesis says every imagination of the thoughts of man's heart was only evil continually; Moses said, 'Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently'; and God told Joshua, 'Only be thou strong and very courageous.'
TheologicalSignificance: My conviction is that 'only' is the Bible's smallest fence: only evil, only take heed, only be strong — one word that draws the line between all and nothing.
